_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Beyond#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Beyond#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Elphaba の任務に加わる。

A Journey Beyond#001.src: ...Hm? Oh- uh, hello there. Sorry, we have this space reserved for...
A Journey Beyond#001.dst: …ん？ あ、えっと、こんにちは。ごめんなさい、ここは予約済みで…
A Journey Beyond#001.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#002.src: Wait. You might be just what we're looking for. You look like you're capable in combat. How would you like to join a dangerous top secret mission?
A Journey Beyond#002.dst: 待って。あなた、ちょうど探してた人かも。戦えそうね。危険な極秘任務に参加してみない？
A Journey Beyond#002.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#003.src: ...I could have phrased that better. Look, the point is- we need a fourth. Let me give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#003.dst: …今のは言い方が悪かったわ。要するに、四人目が必要なの。まず説明させて。参加したくなければ…別の人を探す。それでどう？ じゃあ、ついてきて。
A Journey Beyond#003.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#004.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#004.dst: 誰だよそいつ？ 本当に四人目を見つけたのか？ 要らないって言っただろ！
A Journey Beyond#004.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#005.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry. I didn't catch your name. {u}? .
A Journey Beyond#005.dst: なぜ間違ってるか、二人で言い続けてるでしょ。こちらは…ごめん、名前を聞いてなかった。{u}？ .
A Journey Beyond#005.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#006.src: ... {u}, is that you? Wow, it's been a while. Sorry, I don't have time to chat right now. We're preparing for a dangerous mission, and...
A Journey Beyond#006.dst: …{u}、あなたなの？ 久しぶりね。ごめん、今は話してる暇がないの。危険な任務の準備中で…
A Journey Beyond#006.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#007.src: Well. Actually, we were looking for a fourth person to join us. And... you look like you fit the requirements for that position. If- if you'd like to join, that is.
A Journey Beyond#007.dst: その…実は、四人目を探してたの。それで…あなたなら条件にぴったりだと思う。も、もし参加してくれるなら、だけど。
A Journey Beyond#007.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#008.src: Tell you what. I'll give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#008.dst: こうしましょう。説明するから、参加したくなければ…別の人を探す。それでどう？ じゃあ、ついてきて。
A Journey Beyond#008.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#009.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#009.dst: 誰だよそいつ？ 本当に四人目を見つけたのか？ 要らないって言っただろ！
A Journey Beyond#009.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#010.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is {u}, we've worked together before.
A Journey Beyond#010.dst: なぜ間違ってるか、二人で言い続けてるでしょ。こちらは {u}、前に一緒に仕事をしたの。
A Journey Beyond#010.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#011.src: Anyway, I want to give them the briefing before we head
A Journey Beyond#011.dst: とにかく、出発する前にこの人に説明を
A Journey Beyond#011.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#012.src: Elphie, I'm back! I finally managed to catch Aegis, but he's not... happy. He thinks we should
A Journey Beyond#012.dst: Elphie、戻ったよ！ やっと Aegis をつかまえたけど、あまり…機嫌がよくない。彼が言うには
A Journey Beyond#012.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#013.src: Oh. {u}? What are you doing here? Gods, it's been a while, hasn't it?
A Journey Beyond#013.dst: あれ、{u}？ どうしてここに？ いやあ、久しぶりだね？
A Journey Beyond#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#014.src: They're our fourth. What were you saying about the Admiral?
A Journey Beyond#014.dst: この人が四人目よ。提督がどうしたって？
A Journey Beyond#014.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#016.src: Nothing. If we have our fourth, we should be all set to go, shouldn't we?
A Journey Beyond#016.dst: 何でもない。四人目がいるなら、もう出発できるよね？
A Journey Beyond#016.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#017.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#017.dst: ええ…そうだけど、先に詳しく説明したいの。危険な任務だから…全部伝えておくべきだと思う。
A Journey Beyond#017.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#018.src: So! You're aware of the {p}, yes? Hundreds of years ago, mining operations took place to extract emeralds from the earth. Until, for some unknown reason, they were halted.
A Journey Beyond#018.dst: さて！ {p} は知ってるわよね？ 何百年も前、地中からエメラルドを掘り出す採掘が行われていた。でも理由不明のまま中止されたの。
A Journey Beyond#018.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#019.src: We don't know everything, but... evidence suggests they broke through to an undiscovered section of the Wynn province. There, they found... something.
A Journey Beyond#019.dst: 全部はわかってないけど…証拠によると、彼らは Wynn 地方の未発見の区域まで掘り抜いた。そこで…何かを見つけたの。
A Journey Beyond#019.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#020.src: The land itself was said to be cursed. Not corrupted they were very clear on that.
A Journey Beyond#020.dst: その土地そのものが呪われていたそうよ。腐敗ではない、そこははっきり書いてあった。
A Journey Beyond#020.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#021.src: Some other force makes its home in that place. The few reports we could find refer to it only as the Silent Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#021.dst: 別の力があの地に住みついている。わずかな報告書は、そこを Silent Expanse とだけ呼んでいるわ。
A Journey Beyond#021.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#022.src: The mines were sealed to prevent the spread of this new threat, but the cracks are beginning to show.
A Journey Beyond#022.dst: 新たな脅威の拡散を防ぐために鉱山は封鎖されたけど、ほころびが見え始めている。
A Journey Beyond#022.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#023.src: Strange and otherworldly creatures have begun to find their way through, threatening our province.
A Journey Beyond#023.dst: 奇妙な異界の生き物が抜け出してきて、この地方を脅かしているの。
A Journey Beyond#023.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#024.src: The existence of this place has been kept on a strict need-to-know basis.
A Journey Beyond#024.dst: この場所の存在は、知る必要のある者だけの機密とされてきた。
A Journey Beyond#024.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#025.src: That's where we come in! We're to battle our way through the mines, and scout out the potential danger level.
A Journey Beyond#025.dst: そこで僕らの出番さ！ 鉱山を戦いながら進み、危険度を偵察するんだ。
A Journey Beyond#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#026.src: And we aren't going to be able to do it if we keep sitting around! The newbie's been briefed, let's get going already!
A Journey Beyond#026.dst: 座ってばかりじゃ何もできねえぞ！ 新入りへの説明は済んだ、さっさと行こうぜ！
A Journey Beyond#026.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#027.src: H-hey! What're you doing to my fine establishment!
A Journey Beyond#027.dst: お、おい！ 俺の立派な店に何してくれてんだ！
A Journey Beyond#027.speaker: Rusty Bartender

A Journey Beyond#028.src: ...Shoot. Forgot he was still here. Sorry, barkeep! I'll fix it!
A Journey Beyond#028.dst: …やべ。まだいたの忘れてた。悪いなマスター！ 直しとくから！
A Journey Beyond#028.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#029.src: Lucio, you can't keep... ugh, forget it. I'll gather our supplies... Aledar, can you get us to the mines?
A Journey Beyond#029.dst: Lucio、いつもそうやって…はあ、もういい。私は物資を集める…Aledar、鉱山まで案内できる？
A Journey Beyond#029.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#030.src: Yes, ma'am! {u}, when you're ready, let's get going.
A Journey Beyond#030.dst: 了解です！ {u}、準備ができたら出発しよう。
A Journey Beyond#030.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#031.src: Follow your team towards the Silent Expanse's entrance.
A Journey Beyond#031.dst: チームについて Silent Expanse の入口へ向かう。

A Journey Beyond#032.dst: みんな準備はいい？ 僕が先導する。
A Journey Beyond#032.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#033.src: It's a twist of fate that our paths have converged here, {u}. We started our journey together and now...
A Journey Beyond#033.dst: ここで道が交わるなんて運命のいたずらだね、{u}。一緒に旅を始めて、今は…
A Journey Beyond#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#036.src: Ah, no problem. I'll take care of these.
A Journey Beyond#036.dst: ああ、大丈夫。こいつらは任せて。
A Journey Beyond#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#037.src: No more running for us, huh ? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#037.dst: もう逃げなくていいんだね？ ああ、着いたよ。
A Journey Beyond#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#038.src: This is actually our second attempt. The first time, it didn't go too well.
A Journey Beyond#038.dst: 実はこれが二度目の挑戦なの。一度目はうまくいかなかった。
A Journey Beyond#038.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#039.src: We have more numbers now, Lucio and yourself should help us overpower it.
A Journey Beyond#039.dst: 今回は人数が多い。Lucio とあなたがいれば押さえ込めるはず。
A Journey Beyond#039.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#040.src: Can't be that strong, bet I can take it myself.
A Journey Beyond#040.dst: そんなに強いわけねえ。俺一人で倒せるって。
A Journey Beyond#040.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#041.src: We managed to seal it in but with the {~} of us I'm sure we ca-
A Journey Beyond#041.dst: なんとか封じ込めたけど、{~} 人いればきっと倒せ―
A Journey Beyond#041.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#045.src: What's the big deal? You said yourself we can take it!
A Journey Beyond#045.dst: 何が問題なんだよ？ 勝てるって自分で言ったろ！
A Journey Beyond#045.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#053.dst: やめて！ みんなを傷つけないで！
A Journey Beyond#053.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#054.dst: 痛っ！ これじゃ効かない…
A Journey Beyond#054.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#055.src: Is it just me or are our attacks doing NOTHING?
A Journey Beyond#055.dst: 気のせいか？ 俺らの攻撃、まったく効いてねえぞ？
A Journey Beyond#055.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#056.src: Lucio's right! Change of plan. Lucio, help me hold it in place.
A Journey Beyond#056.dst: Lucio の言う通り！ 作戦変更。Lucio、押さえるのを手伝って。
A Journey Beyond#056.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#057.src: Aledar, you know what to do.
A Journey Beyond#057.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#058.src: {u}, come with me! Cast a spell to block the cave's entrance so the monster can't leave.
A Journey Beyond#058.dst: {u}、一緒に来て！ 呪文で洞窟の入口を塞いで、怪物を出られなくするんだ。
A Journey Beyond#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#059.src: I'll block it from attacking, you block it up with a spell.
A Journey Beyond#059.dst: 僕が攻撃を防ぐから、君は呪文で入口を塞いで。
A Journey Beyond#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#060.src: They won't be able to hold it for long.
A Journey Beyond#060.dst: 二人は長くはもたない。
A Journey Beyond#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#061.dst: いいか？！ 何でもいい、呪文を！
A Journey Beyond#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#063.src: Plan a way of killing the beast.
A Journey Beyond#063.dst: 野獣を倒す方法を考える。

A Journey Beyond#065.dst: おーい…助けて？ 挟まった！
A Journey Beyond#065.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#066.src: Phew, here. Let me get you out.
A Journey Beyond#066.dst: ふう、ほら。出してあげる。
A Journey Beyond#066.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#067.src: I'm sorry, team. I've never seen a monster like that before.
A Journey Beyond#067.dst: 悪い、みんな。あんな怪物は初めて見た。
A Journey Beyond#067.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#068.src: It looks like our problem isn't fire power. It's something else. It's like our weapons just didn't affect it at all.
A Journey Beyond#068.dst: 問題は火力じゃないみたいだ。何か別のものだ。武器がまるで効いていなかった。
A Journey Beyond#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#069.src: I know someone who might be able to help us. A blacksmith on {p}.
A Journey Beyond#069.dst: 助けてくれそうな人を知ってる。{p} の鍛冶屋だ。
A Journey Beyond#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#070.src: {u}, I've written the house's coordinates on your book. Meet us there.
A Journey Beyond#070.dst: {u}、家の座標をあなたの本に書いておいた。そこで合流よ。
A Journey Beyond#070.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#071.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で他の兵士たちと合流する。

A Journey Beyond#072.src: Just in time. We're all here.
A Journey Beyond#072.dst: ちょうどよかった。全員そろったわ。
A Journey Beyond#072.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#073.src: It looks like the Blacksmith knows what's wrong...
A Journey Beyond#073.dst: 鍛冶屋さんは原因がわかってるみたい…
A Journey Beyond#073.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#074.src: So, Dren. Do you know why we can't damage the beast?
A Journey Beyond#074.dst: それで、Dren。どうして野獣に攻撃が効かないの？
A Journey Beyond#074.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#075.src: Certainly! Your issue is elemental. As you know, there are {~} elements...
A Journey Beyond#075.dst: もちろんだとも！ 問題は属性だ。知っての通り、属性は {~} つ…
A Journey Beyond#075.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#081.src: But.. There is a hidden element, Darkness .
A Journey Beyond#081.dst: だが…隠された属性がある。闇だ。
A Journey Beyond#081.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#082.src: Thank grook for that. I was wondering if we'd ever be rid of this nightmare.
A Journey Beyond#082.dst: grook に感謝だな。この悪夢から抜け出せるのかと思ってたよ。

A Journey Beyond#083.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry, I didn't catch your name. {u}? {u}.
A Journey Beyond#083.dst: なぜ間違ってるか、二人で言い続けてるでしょ。こちらは…ごめん、名前を聞いてなかった。{u}？ {u}。

A Journey Beyond#085.src: In order to damage a creature of Darkness, you must remove that influence from your soul.
A Journey Beyond#085.dst: 闇の生き物を傷つけるには、自分の魂からその影響を取り除かねばならん。
A Journey Beyond#085.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#086.src: Some Dark creatures use a sort of synchronous barrier that prevents them being harmed by other creatures influenced with Darkness.
A Journey Beyond#086.dst: 一部の闇の生き物は同調障壁のようなものを使い、闇の影響を受けた者からの攻撃を防ぐのだ。
A Journey Beyond#086.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#087.src: In order to purify you, I will need {~} powerful items.
A Journey Beyond#087.dst: お前たちを浄化するには、強力な品が {~} つ必要だ。
A Journey Beyond#087.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#088.src: Firstly, a shard from a Dernic Beast. There is one living in the depths of the {p}.
A Journey Beyond#088.dst: まずは Dernic Beast の欠片。{p} の奥深くに一匹棲んでいる。
A Journey Beyond#088.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#089.src: I will use this to reveal the darkness element in you all.
A Journey Beyond#089.dst: これで皆の中の闇属性をあぶり出す。
A Journey Beyond#089.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#090.src: And then, of course, a Light item, to purify all of you...
A Journey Beyond#090.dst: そしてもちろん、皆を浄化する光のアイテムだ…
A Journey Beyond#090.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#091.src: Wait... what do you mean a Light item?
A Journey Beyond#091.dst: 待てよ…光のアイテムって何だ？
A Journey Beyond#091.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#092.src: Something from any Light creature would work, you could get some dust from Gavel fairies if you wanted.
A Journey Beyond#092.dst: 光の生き物のものなら何でもいい。Gavel の妖精の粉でも構わんよ。
A Journey Beyond#092.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#094.src: Alright. Aledar, you get the darkness item with {u}, and I'll go get the Light item with Lucio.
A Journey Beyond#094.dst: わかった。Aledar は {u} と闇のアイテムを、私は Lucio と光のアイテムを取りに行く。
A Journey Beyond#094.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#096.dst: Aledar と一緒に欠片を手に入れる。

A Journey Beyond#097.src: Here we are, the roots of Corruption. Let's go, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#097.dst: 着いた、腐敗の根源だ。行こう、{u}！
A Journey Beyond#097.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#098.src: We found that the caves around the roots are far more complex than we thought...
A Journey Beyond#098.dst: 根の周りの洞窟は、思っていたよりずっと複雑だとわかってね…
A Journey Beyond#098.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#099.src: There's one with far more powerful creatures... Somewhere... Here!
A Journey Beyond#099.dst: ずっと強い生き物がいる洞窟がある…どこかに…ここだ！
A Journey Beyond#099.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#100.src: What are you waiting for? Let's go!
A Journey Beyond#100.dst: 何を待ってるんだ？ 行こう！
A Journey Beyond#100.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#101.src: I don't think we can spell our way across, {u}! We need something like... Wings!
A Journey Beyond#101.dst: 呪文じゃ渡れそうにないよ、{u}！ 必要なのは…翼みたいなものだ！
A Journey Beyond#101.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#102.src: I've never used wings like this before...
A Journey Beyond#102.dst: こんな翼、使ったことないな…
A Journey Beyond#102.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#103.src: I think if we just hold them and walk normally, it should help us glide across.
A Journey Beyond#103.dst: 持ったまま普通に歩けば、滑空して渡れると思う。
A Journey Beyond#103.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#104.src: Don't drop them and don't get hit by the lava geysers, obviously.
A Journey Beyond#104.dst: 落とさないように、溶岩の噴出にも当たらないように。当然だけど。
A Journey Beyond#104.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#105.src: Don't forget why we are here, we're looking for a creature of darkness. Shout for me if you find one.
A Journey Beyond#105.dst: 目的を忘れないで。探しているのは闇の生き物だ。見つけたら呼んでくれ。
A Journey Beyond#105.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#106.src: Go deeper into the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the Shard.
A Journey Beyond#106.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟の奥へ進み、欠片を探す。

A Journey Beyond#107.src: That's our target! Go after it!
A Journey Beyond#107.dst: あれが標的だ！ 追え！
A Journey Beyond#107.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#108.src: Wait, why isn't it fighting us here? Careful! It might be trapped!
A Journey Beyond#108.dst: 待って、なぜここで反撃しない？ 気をつけて！ 追い詰められてるのかも！
A Journey Beyond#108.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#109.src: Chase the beast for the Shard.
A Journey Beyond#109.dst: 野獣を追って欠片を手に入れる。

A Journey Beyond#110.src: Kill the Progenitors to open up the entrance.
A Journey Beyond#110.dst: Progenitor を倒して入口を開く。

A Journey Beyond#111.src: Kill the Mangled Progeny for the [{~} Corrupted Pearl].
A Journey Beyond#111.dst: Mangled Progeny を倒して [{~} Corrupted Pearl] を手に入れる。

A Journey Beyond#112.src: Wow, I'm impressed . I honestly thought you would need my help.
A Journey Beyond#112.dst: すごいな、感心したよ。正直、僕の助けが要ると思ってた。
A Journey Beyond#112.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#113.src: Well, we got what we came for. Let's head back to Dren.
A Journey Beyond#113.dst: さて、目的の物は手に入った。Dren のところへ戻ろう。
A Journey Beyond#113.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#114.src: Return to the Blacksmith with the Darkness Item.
A Journey Beyond#114.dst: 闇のアイテムを持って鍛冶屋のもとへ戻る。

A Journey Beyond#115.src: Looks like we lucked out on this one. Did you get an item of darkness?
A Journey Beyond#115.dst: 今回は運がよかったようだ。闇のアイテムは手に入ったか？
A Journey Beyond#115.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#116.src: That should do it. Let's see if this will work. Come here !
A Journey Beyond#116.dst: これで足りるはずだ。うまくいくか試そう。こっちへ来い！
A Journey Beyond#116.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#117.src: It's done! You ought to be free of the dark influence. You ought to be able to break through that barrier that was giving you trouble.
A Journey Beyond#117.dst: 終わったぞ！ 闇の影響は消えたはずだ。手こずっていたあの障壁も、これで破れるだろう。
A Journey Beyond#117.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#118.src: Are you sure? I don't feel that different. Well... I guess there's only one way to find out.
A Journey Beyond#118.dst: 本当に？ あまり変わった気がしないけど。まあ…確かめる方法は一つね。
A Journey Beyond#118.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#119.src: Re-open the closed entrance with the other warriors.
A Journey Beyond#119.dst: 他の戦士たちと、封鎖された入口を再び開く。

A Journey Beyond#120.src: Everyone here? Great! Time to finish what I started!
A Journey Beyond#120.dst: 全員いるか？ よし！ 俺が始めたことにケリをつけるぜ！
A Journey Beyond#120.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#121.src: Lucio! No! When will you learn?
A Journey Beyond#121.dst: Lucio！ だめ！ いい加減懲りて！
A Journey Beyond#121.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#122.src: Right, yes. Sorry, what's the plan?
A Journey Beyond#122.dst: あ、そうだな。悪い、作戦は？
A Journey Beyond#122.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#123.src: We don't want that thing to escape, it could cause widespread panic.
A Journey Beyond#123.dst: あれを逃がすわけにはいかない。大騒ぎになるわ。
A Journey Beyond#123.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#124.src: We'll open up a small entrance to get in, and fight it once inside.
A Journey Beyond#124.dst: 小さな入口を開けて中に入り、中で戦うの。
A Journey Beyond#124.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#128.dst: やった…本当にやったわ！
A Journey Beyond#128.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#129.src: We have an extremely old map of the mines to help us, but we have no idea what's waiting for us.
A Journey Beyond#129.dst: 鉱山のとても古い地図はあるけど、何が待ち受けているのかはまったくわからない。
A Journey Beyond#129.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#130.src: I want to warn you, this may well be a one way ticket for all of us.
A Journey Beyond#130.dst: 警告しておく。これは全員にとって片道切符になるかもしれない。
A Journey Beyond#130.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#131.dst: まさか！ これを見ろよ！
A Journey Beyond#131.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#132.src: Rocks are one thing, Lucio. The creatures we're about to face require more than brute strength. You need force of mind.
A Journey Beyond#132.dst: 岩とは話が違うのよ、Lucio。これから戦う相手には腕力だけじゃ足りない。心の強さが要るの。
A Journey Beyond#132.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#133.src: Oh my. Maybe this isn't the best idea.
A Journey Beyond#133.dst: おっと。やめといたほうがいいかもな。
A Journey Beyond#133.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#134.src: It's too late now. We've got to finish this mission.
A Journey Beyond#134.dst: もう手遅れよ。この任務はやり遂げないと。
A Journey Beyond#134.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#136.src: Remember the goal Elphie, we must reach the end of the expanse.
A Journey Beyond#136.dst: 目的を忘れないで、Elphie。この地の果てまで行かないと。
A Journey Beyond#136.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#137.src: It's still empty here. But it looks like they were here only yesterday.
A Journey Beyond#137.dst: ここもまだ誰もいない。でも、つい昨日までいたみたい。
A Journey Beyond#137.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#138.src: I thought you said the miners were here hundreds of years ago?
A Journey Beyond#138.dst: 鉱夫がいたのは何百年も前だって言ってなかったか？
A Journey Beyond#138.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#139.src: They were. I don't know why it would be so well presevered. It's as if nothing has touched it.
A Journey Beyond#139.dst: そうだよ。なぜこんなに保存状態がいいのかわからない。誰も触れていないみたいだ。
A Journey Beyond#139.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#140.src: According to the documents, we need to make our way to the end of the road.
A Journey Beyond#140.dst: 資料によると、この道の終わりまで進む必要がある。
A Journey Beyond#140.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#141.dst: きゃっ！ 虫！ 離れて！
A Journey Beyond#141.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#142.src: So much for nothing being here.
A Journey Beyond#142.dst: 何もいないって話はどこへやら。
A Journey Beyond#142.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#143.src: Why are they only going for me?
A Journey Beyond#143.dst: なんで私ばっかり狙うの？
A Journey Beyond#143.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#144.src: Aledar, how far is it to the end?
A Journey Beyond#144.dst: Aledar、終点まであとどれくらい？
A Journey Beyond#144.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#145.src: I read the same map as you. It didn't even have scale. There should be a bridge ahead, though.
A Journey Beyond#145.dst: 君と同じ地図を見てるんだ。縮尺すら載ってない。でも、この先に橋があるはずだ。
A Journey Beyond#145.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#146.src: Uhh... A destroyed one. And it wasn't cause I blew it up this time!
A Journey Beyond#146.dst: あー…壊れた橋ならな。今回は俺が爆破したんじゃねえぞ！
A Journey Beyond#146.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#147.src: Hmm, well we will have to go around.
A Journey Beyond#147.dst: うーん、回り道するしかないな。
A Journey Beyond#147.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#148.src: This doesn't really look like corruption, does it?
A Journey Beyond#148.dst: これ、腐敗には見えないよね？
A Journey Beyond#148.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#149.src: Uhhh... I'm not feeling very wel-... Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#149.dst: うう…なんだか気分が悪…きゃあああ！
A Journey Beyond#149.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#150.src: Aaahhh! My liver! It took my liver!
A Journey Beyond#150.dst: ああっ！ 肝臓！ 肝臓を取られた！
A Journey Beyond#150.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#151.dst: Elphaba！ だめだ！ 幻覚だ！
A Journey Beyond#151.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#153.src: Aledar, maybe we should just double back now?
A Journey Beyond#153.dst: Aledar、もう引き返したほうがよくないか？
A Journey Beyond#153.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#154.src: Elphaba is an extremely able warrior. We will fight on and find her.
A Journey Beyond#154.dst: Elphaba は非常に優秀な戦士だ。戦い続けて彼女を見つけよう。
A Journey Beyond#154.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#155.src: Do you really think it was just an illusion?
A Journey Beyond#155.dst: 本当にただの幻覚だったと思うか？
A Journey Beyond#155.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#156.src: I'm not sure. I hope so.
A Journey Beyond#156.dst: わからない。そうだといいけど。
A Journey Beyond#156.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#157.src: What if we're infected too? Shouldn't we just go back?
A Journey Beyond#157.dst: 俺たちも感染してたらどうする？ 戻るべきじゃねえか？
A Journey Beyond#157.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#158.src: We can't, Lucio! We have a mission, as you very well know. We continue.
A Journey Beyond#158.dst: 無理だ、Lucio！ 任務があるのは知ってるだろう。先へ進む。
A Journey Beyond#158.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#159.src: Besides, we might be carrying some of those things too. We can't risk them infesting Wynn.
A Journey Beyond#159.dst: それに、僕らもあれを持ち込んでいるかもしれない。Wynn に広げる危険は冒せない。
A Journey Beyond#159.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#160.src: Looks like we need to go around to the right, here?
A Journey Beyond#160.dst: ここは右から回り込むしかなさそうだな？
A Journey Beyond#160.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#161.src: It feels like something is watching us...
A Journey Beyond#161.dst: 何かに見られている気がする…
A Journey Beyond#161.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#162.src: Aledar, what is this place? You didn't tell me there was a city here.
A Journey Beyond#162.dst: Aledar、ここは何だ？ 街があるなんて聞いてねえぞ。
A Journey Beyond#162.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#163.src: There is. A big one, too; there's more ahead. But it doesn't look like anyone's home. The map doesn't have a name for it either.
A Journey Beyond#163.dst: あるんだ。しかも大きい。この先にもまだ続いてる。でも誰も住んでいないようだ。地図にも名前がない。
A Journey Beyond#163.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#164.src: Wait a sec, is that one of the miners? Is she hurt? HEEEEY! YOU OVER THERE!
A Journey Beyond#164.dst: 待て、あれ鉱夫の一人か？ ケガしてる？ おーい！ そこのあんた！
A Journey Beyond#164.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#167.src: Wait, what's going on? Why can't I move?
A Journey Beyond#167.dst: 待て、何が起きてる？ なんで動けねえんだ？
A Journey Beyond#167.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#169.dst: ここはとても危険なの！
A Journey Beyond#169.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#170.src: We can't live alone like this!
A Journey Beyond#170.dst: こんな風に一人で生きていけない！
A Journey Beyond#170.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#173.src: You need to come with us!
A Journey Beyond#173.dst: 私たちと来なきゃだめ！
A Journey Beyond#173.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#174.src: It's the only way to keep you safe!
A Journey Beyond#174.dst: あなたを守るにはそれしかない！
A Journey Beyond#174.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#175.src: It's the only way to make you happy here!
A Journey Beyond#175.dst: ここで幸せになるにはそれしかない！
A Journey Beyond#175.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#176.src: It's the only way to make us feel whole!
A Journey Beyond#176.dst: 私たちが満たされるにはそれしかない！
A Journey Beyond#176.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#177.src: IT'S THE ONLY WAY, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?!
A Journey Beyond#177.dst: それしかないの、わかる？！
A Journey Beyond#177.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#178.src: AAAH! S-Stop screaming at me! I can't understand!!
A Journey Beyond#178.dst: うわああ！ さ、叫ぶのやめろ！ わけわかんねえ！！
A Journey Beyond#178.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#180.dst: 私の話し方、はっきりしてない？
A Journey Beyond#180.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#181.src: CAN'T YOU HEAR WHAT I'M SAYING?
A Journey Beyond#181.dst: 私の言葉が聞こえないの？
A Journey Beyond#181.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#182.dst: あなたは引っ込んでて！
A Journey Beyond#182.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#183.src: No! How did she disable my spell?!
A Journey Beyond#183.dst: くっ！ どうやって僕の呪文を？！
A Journey Beyond#183.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#184.dst: お願い、これが必要なの！
A Journey Beyond#184.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#185.src: YOU'LL BE SO MUCH HAPPIER IF YOU COME ALONG!
A Journey Beyond#185.dst: 一緒に来ればずっと幸せになれる！
A Journey Beyond#185.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#186.src: YOU'LL NEVER HAVE TO WORRY AGAIN!
A Journey Beyond#186.dst: もう二度と心配しなくていい！
A Journey Beyond#186.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#187.dst: 私たちが守ってあげる！
A Journey Beyond#187.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#189.src: Just please, stand still a little longer!
A Journey Beyond#189.dst: お願い、もう少しじっとしてて！
A Journey Beyond#189.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#190.dst: 暖かい場所へ連れていくわ！
A Journey Beyond#190.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#191.src: You won't be hunted! We promise! No one hunts us!
A Journey Beyond#191.dst: もう狩られない！ 約束する！ 誰も私たちを狩らない！
A Journey Beyond#191.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#192.dst: いいの？ いいって言った！
A Journey Beyond#192.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#193.src: THANK YOU! WE WILL GO TOGETHER!
A Journey Beyond#193.dst: ありがとう！ 一緒に行こう！
A Journey Beyond#193.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#194.dst: 私たちといれば安全よ！
A Journey Beyond#194.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#195.src: NO MORE FEAR! NO MORE CONCERN!
A Journey Beyond#195.dst: もう怖くない！ もう悩まない！
A Journey Beyond#195.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#197.src: No no no!! This is bad, really bad! We have to go ! Quick!
A Journey Beyond#197.dst: だめだだめだ！！ まずい、本当にまずい！ 行かないと！ 早く！
A Journey Beyond#197.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#200.src: Wait, you're just one of the miners. This doesn't feel like an illusion...
A Journey Beyond#200.dst: 待て、ただの鉱夫か。これは幻覚じゃない気がする…
A Journey Beyond#200.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#201.src: Look, you need to get out of here. It's not safe- Wait, what's that noise...?
A Journey Beyond#201.dst: いいか、ここから逃げるんだ。危険だ―待て、何の音だ…？
A Journey Beyond#201.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#204.src: Find Aledar, Lucio and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#204.dst: Fallen City で Aledar、Lucio、Elphaba を見つける。

A Journey Beyond#205.src: {u}! She was completely right. You ought to come with us...
A Journey Beyond#205.dst: {u}！ 彼女の言う通りだった。お前も俺たちと来いよ…
A Journey Beyond#205.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#206.src: Find Aledar and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#206.dst: Fallen City で Aledar と Elphaba を見つける。

A Journey Beyond#207.src: Find Aledar in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#207.dst: Fallen City で Aledar を見つける。

A Journey Beyond#209.src: I think my leg is broken. I have a potion to fix it, but I dropped it back up there.
A Journey Beyond#209.dst: 脚が折れたみたいだ。治す薬はあるけど、上に落としてきた。
A Journey Beyond#209.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#210.src: I feel a bit better.. But something is still wrong.
A Journey Beyond#210.dst: 少し楽になった…でも、まだ何かおかしい。
A Journey Beyond#210.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#211.src: Let's just get out of here, soldier on. There's only one way out.
A Journey Beyond#211.dst: とにかくここを出よう、頑張って。出口は一つしかない。
A Journey Beyond#211.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#212.dst: 一緒に飛び降りて、さあ！
A Journey Beyond#212.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#213.dst: うわああああああああ！！！
A Journey Beyond#213.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#214.src: Urrrgh. {u}, this hasn't gone to plan. According to my map we aren't even half way.
A Journey Beyond#214.dst: ううっ。{u}、計画通りにいかないな。地図だとまだ半分も来ていない。
A Journey Beyond#214.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#215.src: I can't walk. But equally we can't stay here.
A Journey Beyond#215.dst: 歩けない。でも、ここにいるわけにもいかない。
A Journey Beyond#215.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#216.src: The mission must be carried out. The plan has changed, but it's imperative we get to the end of this expanse, together.
A Journey Beyond#216.dst: 任務は果たさなきゃならない。計画は変わったけど、一緒にこの地の果てまで行くことが絶対なんだ。
A Journey Beyond#216.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#217.src: No more running for us, huh {u}? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#217.dst: もう逃げなくていいんだね、{u}？ ああ、着いたよ。

A Journey Beyond#218.src: There has to be a way.. Even if you have to push me in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#218.dst: 何か方法があるはずだ…君がこれで僕を押していくことになっても！
A Journey Beyond#218.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#219.src: No, I'm not joking. You guard the cart, I'll lead the way.
A Journey Beyond#219.dst: いや、冗談じゃない。君はカートを守って、僕が道案内する。
A Journey Beyond#219.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#220.src: Escort Aledar through the {p} to {p} at ({~}, -{~}).
A Journey Beyond#220.dst: Aledar を護衛して {p} を抜け、({~}, -{~}) の {p} へ向かう。

A Journey Beyond#221.src: According to the map, the miners started a town a little ahead.
A Journey Beyond#221.dst: 地図によると、鉱夫たちがこの少し先に町を作ったらしい。
A Journey Beyond#221.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#222.src: Who knows what's left, but it's got to be safer than here.
A Journey Beyond#222.dst: 何が残ってるかわからないけど、ここよりは安全なはずだ。
A Journey Beyond#222.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#223.src: I think the Small Monsters will try to Kill me.
A Journey Beyond#223.dst: 小さい怪物は僕を殺しに来ると思う。
A Journey Beyond#223.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#224.src: While the Big Monsters will try to Kill you.
A Journey Beyond#224.dst: 大きい怪物は君を殺しに来るだろう。
A Journey Beyond#224.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#225.src: It's going to be on you to make sure we both get through this.
A Journey Beyond#225.dst: 二人とも無事に抜けられるかは君にかかってる。
A Journey Beyond#225.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#226.src: The fate of the mission relies on the two of us working together.
A Journey Beyond#226.dst: 任務の成否は、僕ら二人の連携にかかっている。
A Journey Beyond#226.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#227.src: Are those... Eyes on the trees?
A Journey Beyond#227.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#229.src: Watch out, the small monsters are coming for me! I can't fight in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#229.dst: 気をつけて、小さい怪物がこっちに来る！ この中じゃ戦えない！
A Journey Beyond#229.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#230.dst: また来るぞ！ 集中して！
A Journey Beyond#230.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#231.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#231.dst: よくやった！ もう来ないみたいだ。先へ進もう。
A Journey Beyond#231.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#233.src: Let's keep going! Before they come back.
A Journey Beyond#233.dst: 進もう！ 戻ってくる前に。
A Journey Beyond#233.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#234.src: A lot of those small ones are coming for me!
A Journey Beyond#234.dst: 小さいのがたくさんこっちに来る！
A Journey Beyond#234.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#235.src: This one was close! We're getting close to the town.
A Journey Beyond#235.dst: 今のは危なかった！ 町が近いぞ。
A Journey Beyond#235.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#236.src: We'll have to stop again! We can't go past so many monsters.
A Journey Beyond#236.dst: また止まらないと！ 怪物が多すぎて通れない。
A Journey Beyond#236.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#237.src: We're almost there! I can see the town from here!
A Journey Beyond#237.dst: もうすぐだ！ ここから町が見える！
A Journey Beyond#237.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#239.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#239.dst: よくやった！ もう来ないみたいだ。先へ進もう。
A Journey Beyond#239.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#240.src: Ouch! I got hit! Be careful, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#240.dst: 痛っ！ やられた！ 気をつけて、{u}！
A Journey Beyond#240.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#241.src: Finally, we've arrived... It's not exactly the town on the map.
A Journey Beyond#241.dst: やっと着いた…地図にある町とは少し違うな。
A Journey Beyond#241.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#242.src: The lost miners are here... How? they must be hundreds of years old!
A Journey Beyond#242.dst: 行方不明の鉱夫たちがここに…なぜ？ 何百歳にもなるはずだ！
A Journey Beyond#242.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#243.src: What is this obelisk? It's.. comforting. I recognise this feeling from my time in Gavel.
A Journey Beyond#243.dst: このオベリスクは何だ？ なんだか…安らぐ。Gavel にいた頃に感じたのと同じ感覚だ。
A Journey Beyond#243.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#244.src: Maybe.. It's been touched by the light? If so.. It could heal me.
A Journey Beyond#244.dst: もしかして…光に触れたのか？ だとしたら…僕を治せるかも。
A Journey Beyond#244.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#245.src: Let's see if it does anything to me...
A Journey Beyond#245.dst: 僕に効くか試してみよう…
A Journey Beyond#245.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#246.src: It worked... Kind of. I feel at least {~}.. We still have a ways to go.
A Journey Beyond#246.dst: 効いた…少しは。少なくとも {~} は戻った…まだ先は長い。
A Journey Beyond#246.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#247.src: Let's take some time to gather ourselves before we press on. I'll meet you on the other side of town.
A Journey Beyond#247.dst: 先へ進む前に、少し態勢を整えよう。町の反対側で待ってる。
A Journey Beyond#247.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#000~1.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief {u} on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#000~1.dst: ええ…そうだけど、まず {u} に詳細を説明したいの。危険な任務だから…事情を伝えておくのが一番だと思う。

similar.text: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.

A Journey Beyond#021~1.src: The land itself was said to be cursed. Not corrupted- they were very clear on that.
A Journey Beyond#021~1.dst: その土地そのものが呪われていたそうよ。腐敗ではない- そこははっきり書いてあった。
A Journey Beyond#021~1.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#069~1.src: It looks like our problem isn't firepower. It's something else. It's like our weapons just didn't affect it at all.
A Journey Beyond#069~1.dst: 問題は火力じゃないみたいだ。何か別のものだ。武器がまるで効いていなかった。
A Journey Beyond#069~1.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#094~1.src: Alright. Aledar, you get the Darkness item with {u}, and I'll go get the Light item with Lucio.
A Journey Beyond#094~1.dst: よし。Aledar は {u} と闇のアイテムを取ってきて。私は Lucio と光のアイテムを取りに行く。
A Journey Beyond#094~1.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#149~1.src: Uhhh... I'm not feeling really wel-... Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#149~1.dst: うう…なんだか気分が悪…あああっ！
A Journey Beyond#149~1.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#210~1.src: I feel a bit better.. But something's still wrong.
A Journey Beyond#210~1.dst: 少し楽になった..でもまだ何かおかしい。
A Journey Beyond#210~1.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#246~1.src: It worked... Kind of. I feel at least {~}. We still have a ways to go.
A Journey Beyond#246~1.dst: 効いた…一応。少なくとも {~} くらいは。まだ先は長いね。
A Journey Beyond#246~1.speaker: Aledar
